text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: A dot product of two 64-dimensional unit-variance vectors has variance 64,

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: so raw scores swing over roughly ±8. Softmax of values that spread out is

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: almost one-hot, and its gradient p(1−p) collapses to zero — the layer stops

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: learning. Dividing by √64 = 8 restores unit variance and keeps softmax in

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e
font-weight: 600; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Read it as a soft dictionary lookup

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Each query is compared against every key by dot product.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: A hard lookup would take the single best-matching key;

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: softmax takes a weighted blend instead — which is what

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: makes the whole operation differentiable, and therefore

font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b
